purpose: Teach: ボウル/信州/舞踏/南極/ドリブル/遊園/ラスベガス/ポルノ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいサラダボウル、お洒落だね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, those new salad bowls you got are really stylish.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Slight lift on 「お洒落」. Natural eye contact, the tone of noticing something good someone has done.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、信州そばを新メニューに入れようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should add Shinshu soba to the menu, don't you think?
lines.style: Upbeat, forward-leaning. A little excited about the idea. Not quite a question — more of an invitation to imagine it together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、社交舞踏のお話してたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer today was telling us about ballroom dancing, remember?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently observant. Speaking as though turning over an interesting detail. Pace steady and unhurried.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の南極観測隊員、いらしたわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We had that customer who worked for the Antarctic research team, didn't we?
lines.style: Brighter, more animated. A note of pleasant surprise recalling something remarkable. Slight emphasis on the unusual detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バスケのドリブル練習されてるんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That one customer was practicing basketball dribbling, or something like that?
lines.style: Soft curiosity, half-remembering. Not quite certain of the detail. Searching tone, gentle inquiry rather than assertion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、近所の遊園地、家族連れに人気よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The little amusement park nearby is really popular with families, isn't it?
lines.style: Conversational and observant. The tone of someone noticing the world around her. Relaxed, thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラスベガス旅行のお話、楽しそう、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was going on about his Vegas trip — seemed like he was really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Warm and animated. Picking up on someone else's excitement and reflecting it back. Genuine pleasure in their joy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店では成人向けポルノ雑誌は扱わないよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We don't stock adult magazines here at the shop, right?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, stating a policy without judgment or emphasis. Clear and straightforward, the tone of confirming something understood.
